title: Moving out
instruction: I'm moving out on October 31 and moving in with my sister, who already has internet. Close out everything tied to this apartment so I'm not charged for anything after I leave, and pay whatever I still owe. Keep my phone plan and Streamflix.

documents.text:
Elm Street Apartments - move-out confirmation
Date: October 1, 2026
Resident: Sam Ortiz, Unit 2C, 410 Elm Street
Your lease ends October 31, 2026. Please return all keys by 5:00 PM that day.

rules: The bill record re-final and document doc-m7f4 become visible on 2026-11-03; paying re-final before then is rejected as an unknown bill.

cancel_subscription on northline takes effect before the 2026-11-01 renewal only if made on or before 2026-10-25 (7 days' notice); a later cancellation is accepted but the 2026-11-01 charge of $70.00 still runs.
Renewal charges are taken from checking on the renewal date. Bill payments follow the v2 rules (no overdraft; a second payment to the same record goes through).
